page.overview:
Who is Chocolina?

Chocolina is a non-player character in the Lightning Saga. A little chocobo with a strong will, she was purchased by Sazh Katzroy for his son Dajh, but Sazh never had a chance to give her to his son before the Purge. In the interim, Chocolina accompanies Sazh and lives in his afro.

Chocolina is unnamed in Final Fantasy XIII, and is referred to as the chocobo chick or simply "chocobo" by Sazh. In Final Fantasy XIII-2 it is revealed that Dajh had named her.

She is known as Chocolatte in World of Final Fantasy.

;First entry - Added during Chapter Three, in Lake Bresha The chocobo chick travels in Sazh's hair. Though it has only been with Sazh for a short while, a strong bond has formed between them.
